title: Coherence of formal monoidal structural arrows
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category], without a braiding or symmetry assumption. Fix a set $S$ of formal letters and an assignment $s\mapsto X_s$ of objects of $\mathcal C$. A formal tensor expression is built from letters in $S$, a unit symbol, and parenthesized binary tensor products. A formal structural arrow is built from identity arrows, associators, left and right unitors and their inverses, by composition and tensor product, with specified formal source and target expressions. Interpret an expression in $\mathcal C$ using $X_s$, the tensor unit, and the specified tensor product, and interpret structural arrows using the monoidal constraints. For any two formal structural arrows with the same formal source and the same formal target, their interpretations in $\mathcal C$ are equal. In particular all reassociations and insertions or removals of unit symbols between fixed formal expressions give the same morphism. No arbitrary extra generating morphisms and no permutations of letters are included in a structural arrow.
